rationale: Admitted family x trait systems differ in the number of species contributing to rho. The primary model remains deliberately unweighted, but a fixed coverage adjustment is predeclared to test whether the family-vs-trait variance architecture depends on system size.

sensitivity.predictor: z_log_species = z-score of log(n_species_S3) across the identical final crossed-core systems
sensitivity.role: mandatory secondary robustness only; cannot replace or redefine the primary intercept-only result
